description: This file defines classes and functions for an AI task management system called BabyAGI, including task creation, prioritization, execution, and orchestration logic, with external dependencies on langchain libraries.

classes.name: TaskCreationChain
classes.description: Extends LLMChain to create tasks based on a prompt template and language model.

classes.name: TaskPrioritizationChain
classes.description: Extends LLMChain to prioritize and format task lists.

classes.name: ExecutionChain
classes.description: Extends LLMChain to perform individual task execution based on a prompt template.

classes.name: BabyAGI
classes.description: Main class orchestrating task creation, prioritization, execution, and storage, managing a task list with iterative processing.

methods.name: getNextTask
methods.description: Generates new tasks based on previous results and incomplete task list.

methods.name: prioritizeTasks
methods.description: Reorders and formats task list based on objective and current task ID.

methods.name: get_top_tasks
methods.description: Retrieves top relevant documents from vector store based on a query.

methods.name: executeTask
methods.description: Performs a task using the execution chain and context from vector store.
